$comment: Vendored. OpenAI publishes no schema for the Codex plugin manifest, so this one is derived from the manifests Codex has actually cached on this machine: ~/.codex/.tmp/plugins/plugins/hyperframes/.codex-plugin/plugin.json for the skills-only shape, and the linear and notion plugins for the remote-MCP shape (`mcpServers` naming a sibling .mcp.json). The optional fields below are the ones those manifests use and this bundle does not; the enums list the values observed there. Checked against those three: linear and notion validate, and hyperframes fails on `mcpServers` alone, which is deliberate — a skills-only plugin legitimately omits it, but an xplainer bundle that lost its MCP declaration would install and then do nothing, so it is required here. Widen this against a real manifest, never against a failing build.
title: Codex plugin manifest

name.description: Plugin identifier. Kebab-case, matching the Claude bundle so one product is not two names.

version.description: Semantic version. Written at build time from the package version.

skills.description: Relative path to the skills directory. A directory path, so it ends in a slash.

apps.description: OpenAI app-directory binding. Unrelated to MCP and unused by this bundle.

mcpServers.description: Relative path to the .mcp.json that declares the remote MCP server.

interface.description: Everything the Codex plugin directory renders. Absent it, the plugin installs but has no listing.

category.description: Directory category. The two values observed in the cached manifests.

defaultPrompt.description: Suggested prompts. Both the single-string and the list form occur in the cached manifests.
